author: Kathy Smalley Stephen
text: This happened to me.  I'm an older woman with "bat wings" when I applied there it troubled me for the whole 15 days.  Once out,  the area was red and swollen.  I reapplied in a meatier spit and I have not had any troubles.  The truth about getting older!  Lol

author: Patrick Xjr
text:
Good morning 
When applying the sensor, you may hit a blood vessel. It is chance..
There is no possibility to predict…I have got this concern twice. 
Effect: more than the pain, if there is some blood issuing from sensor, values will become erratic…false values.
Action: phone to Abbott. You should get a new sensor.
Then avoid to apply sensor at this location in the future.
Other tips: before applying sensor put a bag with ice at the location where you will put the sensor during 20 seconds. Cold will reduce vessels…
Good luck
